lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: سُوٓءَ is in the derivative form: سُوء
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/و/أ   s–w–ʾ to be or become bad, evil, wicked
; to deteriorate; to afflict, to hurt, to vex, to torment, to trouble, to make sorry.

Of this root, 12 forms occur 167 times in the Qur’an:
ساء sāʾa 27 times; سيئَ sıʾa 3 times;أساء ʾasāʾa 5 times; سَوء sawʾ 9 times;سُوءَ sūʾa 1 time; سَيّء sayyiʾ 4 times;سَيّئةٌ sayyiʾatun 22 times;سَيّئات sayyiʾāt 36 times;سَوْءة sawʾatun 2 times; سَوءات sawʾāt 5 times; أسْوأ ʾaswaʾ 2 times and مُسيء musıʾ 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سُوء sūʾ [n.]

1 evil

(12:53) إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لأََمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ indeed man’s very soul incites him to evil

2 punishment, harm

(13:11) وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلاَ مَرَدَّ لَهُ and if God wills harm on a people, there is no turning it back

3 indecency, malice, abuse

(12:25) قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا she said, ‘What is a [befitting] punishment for someone who intended harm to your wife?’

4 affliction, corruption, disease

(28:32) اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ put your hand inside your garment and it will come out white with no affliction [vitiligo]

5 adversity, badness, severity

(13:21) وَيَخَافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ and they dread the severity of the Reckoning.

entries.label: أساء
entries.definitionHtml:
أساء ʾasāʾa I [v. IV, intrans.] to act badly, to act abominably

(53:31) لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا He will repay those who act badly according to their deeds II [v. trans.] to hurt, to harm, to offend

(30:10) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا السُّوأَى أَنْ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ then the end of those who committed the worst abomination was that they denied God’s revelations.

entries.label: أسْوأ
entries.definitionHtml:
أسْوأ ʾaswaʾ [elat.] worse, worst

(39:35) لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا that God might absolve them [even] of their worst deeds.

entries.label: السُّوأَى
entries.definitionHtml:
السُّوأَى ʾal‐sūʾā [ nominalised fem. elat.] the worst there is, the most abominable thing

(30:10) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا السُّوأَى أَنْ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ then the end of those who committed the worst abomination was that they denied God’s revelations.

entries.label: ساء
entries.definitionHtml:
ساء sāʾa u I [v. intrans.] this particular form of the verb occurs only in the perfect and is always used interjectionally in the sense of ‘How very bad!’, ‘How ill‐advised!’, ‘How abominable!’

(16:59) يَتَوَارَى مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَى هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِى التُّرَابِ أَلاَ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ he hides away from the people because of the evil of what he has been told; should he keep it [the newly born baby girl] in humiliation (or, and suffer humiliation himself) or bury it in the dust?, how evil is their judgement! II [v. trans.; pass. سيءَ sıʾa] to afflict, to displease, to grieve, to cause agony, to injure

(3:120) إِنْ تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ if any goodness comes to you it grieves them.

entries.label: سَوْء
entries.definitionHtml:
سَوْء sawʾ [n./ v. n.]

1 evil, corruption, torment

(16:60) لِلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالآخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ وَلِلَّهِ الْمَثَلُ الأَعْلَى for those who do not believe in the Hereafter are evil attributes and for God are the sublime ones

2 harm, injury, damage, destruction

(25:40) وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ indeed they pass by the town on which destruction was rained; *

(48:6) عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ upon them is defeat in battle [lit. the injurious turn of fortune].

entries.label: سَوْءةَ
entries.definitionHtml:
سَوْءةَ sawʾatun [n.; pl.سَوءات sawʾāt] shame, shameful parts, private parts, nakedness

(7:26) يَابَنِي ءَادَمَ قَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْآتِكُمْ children of Adam, We have given you garments to cover your shameful parts; *

(5:31) سَوْأَةَ أَخِيهِ his brother’s exposed dead body.

entries.label: سَيّء
entries.definitionHtml:
سَيّء sayyiʾ [quasi‐act. part.] bad, malevolent

(35:43) اسْتِكْبَارًا فِى الأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلاَ يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلاَّ بِأَهْلِهِ acting arrogantly in the land, and devising evil–the devising of evil rebounds only on its own people.

entries.label: سَيِّئةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
سَيِّئةٌ sayyiʾatun I [n.; pl. سَيِّئَاتُ sayyiʾāt]

1 sin

(2:81) بَلَى مَنْ كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَأَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُهُ فَأُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ truly those who commit a sin and their sin gains mastery over them–these will be the inhabitants of the Fire

2 affliction

(4:79) وَمَا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِنْ نَفْسِكَ and whatever affliction befalls you is from your own self

3 bad deed

(23:96) ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ repel evil/a bad deed with that which is better

4 punishment

(30:36) وَإِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ but when punishment befalls them, because of what their hands have previously committted, they utterly despair

5 bad outcome, harm, bad result

(16:34) فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا so the evil [consequence] of what they had done hit them II [quasi‐act. part.] bad

(4:85) ‏‏وَمَنْ‏ ‏يَشْفَعْ‏ ‏شَفَاعَةً‏ ‏سَيِّئَةً‏ ‏يَكُنْ‏ ‏لَهُ‏ ‏كِفْلٌ‏ ‏مِنْهَا‏ and whoever makes an intercession [for a bad cause] will have a share of it.

entries.label: مُسيء
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسيء musıʾ [act. part.] one who commits bad deeds, evil doer

(40:58) وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلاَ الْمُسِيءُ the blind and the sighted are not equal, any more than those who believe and do good works and those who do evil.
